Mod.name: Mod Guide
Mod.Description: This menu. Lists every installed mod, what it does and how to use it.
Mod.Activate: Press the key below. Choose a mod, then move over each line to read it.

Control.note: Controller: hold the first button, then press the second.

Mod.name: TrainerV
Mod.Description: Trainer with player, vehicle, weapon, world and teleport options, and spawning.
Mod.Activate: On from game start. Open the menu with the key below.

Control.note: Keyboard: then W / S up and down, Numpad 8 / 2 / 4 / 6 to move.

Mod.name: TrainerV hotkeys
Mod.Description: Shortcuts that work without opening TrainerV. Keyboard only. Two keys: hold the first, press the second.

Control.note: Letters: A B C D E F G M N T U X. Left Alt + R spawns a random car.

Mod.name: Menyoo
Mod.Description: Large trainer: spawn vehicles and peds, outfits, animations, weather, time, and the object spooner.
Mod.Activate: Always loaded. Open the menu with the key below.

Control.note: Only when manual respawn is turned on in Menyoo.

Mod.name: Better Chases+
Mod.Description: Realistic police chases: chases escalate in phases, police need permission to PIT or shoot, and escaping leaves an arrest warrant.
Mod.Activate: Works on its own when police chase you. The key below opens its settings.

Mod.name: MapEditor
Mod.Description: Place and save props, peds and vehicles to build your own maps.
Mod.Activate: Press the key below. Controller buttons are shown on screen while it's open.

Mod.name: Stance
Mod.Description: Switches your character into a combat stance.
Mod.Activate: Press the key below on foot.

Control.note: Controller button not yet checked in game.

Mod.name: ImmersifyII
Mod.Description: Living world: gangs with territories, dynamic events (robberies, gang wars, chases), smarter enemies with morale, security cameras and police scenarios.
Mod.Activate: Always on. Interaction prompts and their buttons appear on screen near NPCs.

Mod.name: Cop_Arrest
Mod.Description: Lets you arrest people as police.
Mod.Activate: Its key is fixed inside the mod and isn't known. Check the mod's original readme or try it in game.

Mod.name: Disarm
Mod.Description: Lets you disarm armed NPCs.
Mod.Activate: Its key is fixed inside the mod and isn't known.

Mod.name: FoSAShelter
Mod.Description: Makes the shelter enterable: walk in and you're teleported inside.
Mod.Activate: Walk on foot into the shelter entrance near -489.7, 2233.7, 149.5. Walk into the exit zone inside to leave.

Mod.name: HomeInvasion
Mod.Description: Rob houses around the map. Residents may flee, fight or phone the police, and cops or SWAT then arrive inside.
Mod.Activate: Walk to a red marker (red house blips on the map) with no wanted level and press E. Inside, E takes loot, intimidates a targeted resident, or leaves at the door.
Mod.Config: scripts/HomeInvasion.xml (the Cops block sets wanted level, delay, SWAT and weapons)

Control.note: On-foot context button, near a marker or inside a robbed home.

Mod.name: CruelMasters Online Offline
Mod.Description: Single-player recreation of GTA Online: character editor, session mode, clothes, weapon and mod shops, dealership, phone, contracts and heists. The first launch runs the character editor and switches you to a freemode character.
Mod.Activate: After the intro, press L to start a session. Visit the shops on the map. It replaces the pause menu and can fight RDE and Better Chases+ over wanted levels.

Control.note: After the intro. Also flips the TrainerV right indicator.

Mod.name: iFruitAddon2
Mod.Description: Adds extra contacts from other mods to your phone.
Mod.Activate: Open the phone and go to Contacts.

Mod.name: SHVDN console
Mod.Description: ScriptHookVDotNet console. Shows script errors and runs commands such as Reload().
Mod.Activate: Press the key below. Type Reload() to reload all .NET scripts after editing their settings.

Mod.name: NoEditorRestrictions
Mod.Description: Removes Rockstar Editor limits: the free camera goes through walls and moves anywhere.
Mod.Activate: Works on its own inside the Rockstar Editor.

Mod.name: Lua GUI menu
Mod.Description: Small custom Lua menu (example addin).
Mod.Activate: Off by default. To turn it on, see docs/mods_info/LUA_MENU.md.

Mod.name: openCameraV
Mod.Description: Camera mod.
Mod.Activate: No keybind or settings file found. Log: openCameraV.log.

Mod.name: Add-on vehicles
Mod.Description: Gxetron (gxetron), Lamborghini Urus (urus2018) and BMW i8 (rmodmi8).
Mod.Activate: Menyoo, Vehicle Spawner, Added Models. Or spawn by model name in TrainerV.

Mod.name: Saved Menyoo items
Mod.Description: Ghost Rider bike (three versions), Lamborghini Urus, TheOne, and the Ghost Rider outfit.
Mod.Activate: Vehicles: Menyoo, Vehicle Spawner, Saved Files. Outfit: Menyoo wardrobe, saved outfits.

Mod.name: RDE police overhaul
Mod.Description: Replaces police dispatch (RDE with Expanded & Enhanced, SixStarResponse): a sixth wanted star, roadblocks and tougher units. Works with Better Chases+, which leaves dispatch to it.
Mod.Activate: Always on. Ctrl+F10 turns it off and on.

Mod.name: Map and graphics packs
Mod.Description: forest_n and forest_s add forests to the map. vremastered improves world visuals.
Mod.Activate: Always on.

Mod.name: Background mods
Mod.Description: OpenIV.asi (loads the Mods folder), HeapAdjuster, PackfileLimitAdjuster, WeaponLimitsAdjuster, DecalsLimit-Patch (raise game limits), and the LemonUI, NativeUI and ClearScript libraries.
Mod.Activate: Always on. Nothing to press.
